name: Evergreen Podcast (Ad Revenue + Sponsorships)

yield.notes: CPM for podcast ads: $15-50 per 1,000 downloads. Sponsorships require 1,000+ downloads/episode.

flags: Requires consistent publishing to maintain audience

startup_checklist: Choose evergreen niche (how-to, history, true crime, self-improvement)
Record first 5 episodes before launch (backlog reduces churn after subscribe)
Set up on Buzzsprout or Spotify for Podcasters (free distribution)
Submit to Apple Podcasts, Spotify, and Google Podcasts
Apply to Spotify Audience Network or Podcast.co for dynamic ads at 500+ listeners
failure_modes: Hosting costs exceed revenue at low listener counts
kill_criteria: Less than 200 downloads/episode after 12 months and 50+ episodes
Sponsorship market dries up in niche
sources_note: CPM rates from podcast advertising industry reports.
